advance_rule: A replacement-wave candidate advances only when every zero threshold passes and every declared real reader has non-proxy evidence.

mechanisms.requirement: Equal header/head aliases canonicalize once; unequal aliases quarantine the untouched source and never choose precedence.
Validate every block shape recursively before projection; preserve payload and quarantine malformed or missing required structures.
TUI segments tokens at widths 1/20/40/80/120; public/email use explicit anywhere wrapping and max-width containment with zero clipping.
Every mutation requires an expected revision; mismatch returns typed conflict, writes nothing, and is never erased by retry.
Record byte preimage and digest before mutation; rollback restores exact bytes; quarantine is immutable, reasoned, and idempotent.
Escape or visibly encode C0, ESC, and DEL before every terminal path; emitted control-byte count is zero.
Public, authenticated Studio, TUI, delivered email, and CLI/API consume one validated packet; each real reader must exercise all fixtures and BLOCKED never counts as PASS.
